name: Caldron Magen
languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The magen makes two attacks, using Extended Fist or Acid Spittle in any combination.

items.name: Extended Fist
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Acid damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two fists.

items.name: Acid Spittle
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Acid damage.

items.name: Disintegration
items.notes: If the magen dies, it disintegrates into dust, leaving behind anything it was wearing or carrying.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The magen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Eldritch Eddy
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The eddy makes two attacks, using Searing Swipe or Arcane Bolt in any combination.

items.name: Searing Swipe
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Fire or Lightning damage (eddy's choice).

items.name: Arcane Bolt
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Force damage.

items.name: Eldritch Overload
items.notes: The eddy takes damage. Strength saving throw DC 14, each creature of the eddy's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the eddy. On a failed save, 7 (2d6) Force damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The eddy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Phaerimm Elder
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
spellcasting.notes: The phaerimm casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The phaerimm makes three Mind Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with either (A) a Vicious Stinger attack or (B) a use of Spellcasting to cast Command (level 3 version).

items.name: Mind Lash
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (6d8 + 4) Psychic damage.

items.name: Vicious Stinger
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 26 (4d12) Poison damage, and the target's Speed is reduced to 0 feet until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

items.name: Siphon Magic
items.notes: The phaerimm focuses on a magic item it can see within 10 feet. When it does, the phaerimm drains the magic item of any charges. Regardless of whether charges are drained, the phaerimm can cast Clairvoyance, Geas, Major Image, and Mirage Arcane one additional time that day.

items.name: Teleport
items.notes: The phaerimm teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Phaerimm Scout
languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The phaerimm makes two attacks, using Stinger or Mindwarp Ray in any combination.

items.name: Stinger
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage.

items.name: Mindwarp Ray
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the phaerimm's next turn.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: The phaerimm is hit by an attack roll. The phaerimm halves the damage (round down) it takes from that attack.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The phaerimm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
